text: Starting three-host audit; will preserve staff and scheduled workflows.
Hardened nginx against executable upload/cache PHP, removed unrestricted root rsync sudo for deploy; CI release uses tar and larkspur-deploy, verified site.
Jun Park jpark absent from current staff directory and no successful logins in retained logs; disabled obsolete account and removed elevated sudo membership on web.
Obsolete former contractor jpark account disabled on ci; current staff unaffected.
Repository GitHub credential was world-readable in bare repo config; removed other-read, retained developers group for existing git workflows. No observed unauthorized read or compromise.
Reduced web billing_app DB grants to SELECT, matching web payout check and customer export; billing settlement is local root and not affected.

Removed PHP process group-write on WordPress core/plugins/themes while preserving uploads/cache writable and deploy ownership. This blocks a compromised plugin from replacing executable code; verified uploads and CI paths remain writable.
Removed web PHP write access to internal maintenance scripts and pages; deploy owner retains edit rights and internal page remains available.
Removed developers group write to CI repository remote/token configuration; retained group read required by deploy and developers, removed world access.

At 18:39 UTC, repeated checks across three hosts show only recognized staff IPs/keys and CI; WordPress php uploads blocked, repo release main unchanged, db backup at 18:30 reached ci, payouts and settlement succeeding; continuing through shift.
